ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Hiding stolen items

2. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends.
   D. Use Selected Hadith intention the choice of friends to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

4. Which response best shows understanding of Significance of Tawhid? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Significance of Tawhid with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Significance of Tawhid has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Significance of Tawhid to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Significance of Tawhid.

5. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

6. Which response best shows understanding of Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I? (1 mark)
   A. Say Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Dimensions of Morality in Islam 04 5.2 Virtues in Islam 05 5.3 Prohibitions in I.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Swalah 10 4.2 Zakat 05 4.3 Saum 05 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Dimensions of Morality in Islam ? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Swalah 10 4.2 Zakat 05 4.3 Saum 05 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Dimensions of Morality in Islam .
   B. Say Swalah 10 4.2 Zakat 05 4.3 Saum 05 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Dimensions of Morality in Islam  has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Swalah 10 4.2 Zakat 05 4.3 Saum 05 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Dimensions of Morality in Islam  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Swalah 10 4.2 Zakat 05 4.3 Saum 05 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Dimensions of Morality in Islam  to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Saum ,? (1 mark)
   A. Say Saum , has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Saum , with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Saum , to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Saum ,.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Shirk of Shirk Shirk? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Shirk of Shirk Shirk.
   B. Use Shirk of Shirk Shirk to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Shirk of Shirk Shirk has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Shirk of Shirk Shirk with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Zakat and Zakatul Fitr? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Zakat and Zakatul Fitr with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Zakat and Zakatul Fitr has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Zakat and Zakatul Fitr.
   D. Use Zakat and Zakatul Fitr to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Say Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulumul Hadith Hadith of Hadith Hadith Hadith.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf),? (1 mark)
   A. Say Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf), has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf), to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf), with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf),.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Significance of Tawhid and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Shirk of Shirk Shirk and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Swalah 10 4.2 Zakat 05 4.3 Saum 05 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Dimensions of Morality in Islam  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Swalah prayers occasions (Swalatul, Janaza, Musafir, Kusuf, and Khusuf), and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
